method_notes: Primary vote counts and percentages are taken from the Democratic/Republican primary result boxes on the cited Wikipedia pages (pulled as raw wikitext on 2026-11-04; those boxes cite state election offices), cross-checked against news reports where a news URL is listed. 'turnout' = total votes cast in that party's primary for that office (all-party total for California top-two). general_result_margin = Democratic % minus Republican % in points, from partial election-night counts; null where no sourced percentage was found. general_called = winner per AP/network call where a news URL is listed, otherwise per the winner marker on the Wikipedia 2026 Senate/House/gubernatorial summary tables as of the morning of Nov 4 (not independently verified). Style labels (ideology/posture/archetype) are analyst judgements from endorsements listed on Wikipedia plus news framing; see style_confidence.
